data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The cheapest test for the _reset() guard is a one-line assertion in the existing test_failed_control_append_rolls_live_materialization_back: after the failed append, assert WorkflowReplayState.digest changes (or raises) when _commit's _reset() is deleted. This test would catch the guard dying because the digest would fail to reflect the failed append, making the deletion visible. The failure mode left uncovered if skipped: the append-only record can be silently corrupted by a failed append that the digest does not see, meaning every replay or audit based on the digest is unreliable. This is the highest priority because it is the only gap that corrupts the integrity substrate rather than merely hiding a failure.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If WorkflowReplayState.digest is not consumed by any downstream integrity check or replay mechanism, the blast radius of this gap is smaller than assumed and this test may not be Priority 1.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the existing test already exercises the digest but the _reset() deletion does not affect the digest path, the test may need a different assertion strategy.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If there is a separate integrity check that catches failed appends independently of the digest, this test may be redundant.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The PARKED.md states that test_failed_control_append_rolls_live_materialization_back passes with _commit's _reset() deleted, meaning the test does not exercise the digest's ability to see a failed append. The cheapest fix is to add an assertion to that same test that the digest reflects the failure. The blast radius is maximal because the digest is the integrity substrate: if it cannot see a failed append, the append-only record is forgeable. The RESULTS.md evidence that 44 checks were vacuous, evadable, dead, or absent confirms that the recurring failure class is guards that exist but are not tested\u2014this is exactly that class, at the most critical enforcement site.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
